verdict.rationale: ELSTER's own pages say business tax data such as the VAT pre-return (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung) can be submitted entirely paperless. A free one-time registration issues a certificate for signature-free electronic submission, and the tax-registration questionnaire for a company tax number must be filed electronically. Transmission is confirmed by an Übertragungsprotokoll (transmission receipt). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed founder filing end to end.
